svg.text: Information architecture & user flow • Homework 05 • Nevzat Kayıkçı / JWM27Z
Ordered by relevance to the one ruling task
Excluded: account, saved archive, voice, photo, scores, opponent.
Honest status: THREE real testers still required
Do not present the labels as validated.
Ask 3 players what they would click for 5 concrete tasks.
Screen structure supports the player’s specific goal
Concrete card move; clarify missing detail
Ruling or unknown; cited passage + edition
No profile, catalog, timer, or unrelated dashboard.
Task-focused relationships; exceptions are embedded states
Unsupported ruleset • Clarify • Loading • No source • Conflict • Retry
STARTS with goal before any opening screen · Main route and exceptional outcomes
Main success: player reads the original cited passage, then decides with the group.
E5 · Connection error → show retry, retain game selection and typed question
Distinguish empirical research from designed safeguards
A UNO group searched online and read rules for +2 → +4.
Label meanings, preference for four screens, faster resolution, edition picker,
and feasibility are design hypotheses, not participant findings.
Mobile-first, low-fidelity variants of only the task screens
Add loading, error and keyboard focus treatments.
Run a quick, ethical label comprehension test
Present the same eight labels without hints.
Ask which label fits each of five tasks:
game • edition • question • rule evidence • unknown
Current results: 0 / 3. No claims of validation.
Detailed test prompts and blank log are in the ZIP.
